text:
Project Pricing FAQs

Outside vs Inside Corners

GenStone 90º outside and inside corner panels are unique to the GenStone Made Easy system and are available in all stacked stone and brick colors. These carefully engineered panels eliminate the need to miter and deliver a visually uninterrupted transition between walls.

Ledgers

Each straight ledger delivers 3.50 linear feet of coverage and can be supplemented with outside and inside corner ledgers. The ledgers are used to finish the top of a wainscot installation and offer a sloped design ideal for shedding water.

Trim or No Trim

GenStone trim is available in all stacked stone and brick colors. Panels can terminate into the trim where it is used around obstacles such as hose bibs and electrical boxes. Trim can also be used to create a visual stopping point for partial wall installs.

Left and Right Finished Edges

Also called left and right returns, these 12″ x 12″ panels are available in all stacked stone colors. These panels can be used to wrap the stone around a corner or on a partially installed flat wall, providing an alternative to trim or painting the end of a panel.
